title: Unearthing Shenzhen's Ancient Roots: A Journey Through Fenghuang Village
description: Fenghuang Village is Shenzhen’s historic origin tied to 13th-century patriot Wen Tianxiang. Join Chengxi Yuan to discover the ancient alleys, ancestral halls, and cultural relics contrasting the city’s modernity, revealing a legacy of loyalty, tradition, and resilience preserved for 800 years.
